Dude, it’s so nerdy to call it 0.0.x… Come on, we know “it’s not a final product and far from it” and on and on, but one zero is enough for us to get it. The MVC-people are playing the same word-game, but at least they’re playing with solid figures.

There is not enough Beta/Previews/CTP:s left to justify you counting your way through 0.0.x up to 1.x Beta or something like that.

Otherwise, keep up the good work Jeff!
